messages.subject: Re: Error running commonfactorGWAS
messages.body_plain:
Hi Dan,

Thanks for raising this and apologies for a bit of a delay getting back to you. It had to do with a recent lavaan update with respect to how the model was internally represented that was causing issues with the follow-up independent pathways model used for Q_SNP estimation. I just put in the fix, but let us know if you still have any issues.

-Andrew
